_comment: Gold-set labelers (DECISIONS D4). Each slot is an email or auth user id matched against `profiles`. While `a` and `b` are null the labeling page assigns those two slots by order of first label (a = the first admin to save a gold label, b = the second) and the import script needs --labeler-a / --labeler-b; the `adjudicator` slot exists only when named here (a third admin without it has no slot). This file and goldset-v1.manifest.json are imported at build time: editing either needs a rebuild and a redeploy to reach the page. Fill in when D4 is decided.
